titles.romaji: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Kratos-sensei no Private Lesson
titles.native: クラトス先生の プライべートレスン

description:
A special bonus animation included in the first volume of the Tales of Symphonia DVD.
Lloyd and Collete talk about the special DVD editions, and Professor Kratos gives a summary of the ancient history of the world in Tales of Symphonia.
